# MAM Industries

> Precision metal cutting, 3kW CNC fiber laser cutting, 250-ton CNC metal bending, fiber laser metal marking, MIG/TIG/CO2/laser welding, powder coating, and custom sheet metal fabrication in Bengaluru — serving Bangalore, Karnataka, and pan-India B2B OEMs.

## Geographic Service Coverage (Local, State & National)
- **Bengaluru Industrial Zones**: Yelachenahalli, Kanakapura Road, Peenya, Bommasandra, Jigani, Electronic City, Whitefield, Hosur Road, Mysore Road, Yeshwanthpur
- **Karnataka State**: Bengaluru, Mysuru, Tumakuru, Hubballi-Dharwad, Mangaluru, Belagavi, Shivamogga, Hosapete, and bordering Hosur (TN)
- **National (Pan-India Supply)**: Scheduled B2B OEM dispatch, JIT supply contracts, and pan-India road/logistics shipping for prototypes and bulk production batches

## Core Capabilities & Technical Specifications
- **Metal Cutting / 3kW CNC Fiber Laser Cutting**: 2000 mm x 4000 mm bed size, ±0.1 mm linear tolerance. Cuts Mild Steel (MS 0.8–16 mm), Stainless Steel (SS 0.8–8 mm), Aluminium (Al 0.1–5 mm), and Galvanised Iron (GI 0.8–4 mm).
- **Metal Bending / 250-Ton CNC Press Brake**: 2500 mm bed length, ±0.05° angular accuracy. Forms MS (0.8–8 mm), SS (0.8–6 mm), Aluminium (1–6 mm), and GI (0.8–4 mm).
- **Metal Marking / Fiber Laser Marking & Engraving**: Permanent, abrasion-proof QR codes, 2D Data Matrix barcodes, sequential serial numbers, part numbers, and logos on SS, MS, aluminium, brass, copper, and anodised surfaces.
- **Metal Welding**: Production MIG/CO2 welding, architectural-grade TIG welding, resistance spot/arc welding, and low-HAZ handheld fiber laser welding.
- **Surface Finishing & Powder Coating**: RAL colour matching, salt-spray tested powder coating, hot-dip galvanising, and electroplating.
- **Turnkey Fabrication & Structures**: Electrical enclosures, brackets, machine guards, rolling shutters (manual & motorized), industrial security gates & grills, and Pre-Engineered Buildings (PEB) / industrial sheds.
- **Accepted CAD Formats**: .DXF, .DWG, .STEP, .STP, .IGS, and dimensioned PDF blueprints. Turnaround: 3–7 days for prototypes, 1–3 weeks for volume batches, 24-hour quotation SLA.
